title: AlphaFold model with confidence colouring
prompt: Load the AlphaFold DB model of human p53 (UniProt P04637) and colour it by the model's per-residue confidence (pLDDT).

provenance.source: AlphaFold DB AF-P04637-F1 model v6 -> molbench/atom_tables/af-p04637-f1.json.gz
provenance.derived: The July reference was `load P04637` with the alphafold flag. In pdbe-molstar 3.3.2 moleculeId is a PDB id (spec.ts:103) and alphafoldView only switches the colouring to pLDDT (spec.ts:115); it does not fetch a model. The model has to come in as customData pointing at the AlphaFold DB file. The entry is compared as AF-P04637-F1 whatever the file version or format.

notes: Tool-control: custom data source plus a colouring switch.
